notes: State Cliopatria lacks, added by se-04-x; the republic-of-vietnam dossier (se-04-b) calls it the same state under Bảo Đại and starts on 26 October 1955, and Q172640 is shared with DRV: a gap-filler should decide whether to merge the two dossiers (the colour rule makes one state one colour). The French Indochina row (to 1957) overlaps the State of Vietnam throughout 1949-1955: the gain from french-indochina is a transfer of internal sovereignty only, since the state was an associated state in the French Union (defence and foreign relations stayed French until 1954). Page silent: the transfer of the Hanoi and Haiphong zones in 1954-55 and the French withdrawal from the south; the Bình Xuyên and sect armies (not on the pages); the Autonomous Republic of Cochinchina (1946-1949) and the Provisional Central Government of Vietnam (1948-1949), the infobox predecessors, are not drawn. The infobox lists no area. Page budget: 2 pages.
